cases.name: array-copy-forward
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: array-copy-reverse
cases.source: function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} "ok";

cases.name: object-copy-forward
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return {value:b(n)};} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: object-copy-reverse
cases.source: function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function a(n:uint32){return {value:b(n)};} "ok";

cases.name: mixed-three-forward
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32){return c(n);} function c(n:uint32){return {value:a(n)};} "ok";

cases.name: mixed-three-reverse
cases.source: function c(n:uint32){return {value:a(n)};} function b(n:uint32){return c(n);} function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} "ok";

cases.name: finite-seed-forward
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return n>1?[b(n)]:0;} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: finite-seed-reverse
cases.source: function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function a(n:uint32){return n>1?[b(n)]:0;} "ok";

cases.name: boolean-seed-forward
cases.source: function a(flag:boolean){return flag?{value:b(flag)}:null;} function b(other:boolean){return a(other);} "ok";

cases.name: boolean-seed-reverse
cases.source: function b(other:boolean){return a(other);} function a(flag:boolean){return flag?{value:b(flag)}:null;} "ok";

cases.name: two-components-forward
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function c(n:uint32){return {value:d(n)};} function d(n:uint32){return c(n);} "ok";

cases.name: two-components-reverse
cases.source: function d(n:uint32){return c(n);} function c(n:uint32){return {value:d(n)};} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} "ok";

cases.name: finite-outgoing-forward
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return n>1?[b(n)]:c(n);} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function c(n:uint32){return 0;} "ok";

cases.name: finite-outgoing-reverse
cases.source: function c(n:uint32){return 0;} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function a(n:uint32){return n>1?[b(n)]:c(n);} "ok";

cases.name: growing-with-unrelated-unknown
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function c(n:uint32){return missing;} "ok";

cases.name: acyclic-consumer-of-growth
cases.source: function wrap(n:uint32){return [a(n)];} function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: nested-component
cases.source: function outer(n:uint32){function a(m:uint32){return [b(m)];} function b(m:uint32){return a(m);} return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: acyclic-construction
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32){return [c(n)];} function c(n:uint32){return 0;} "ok";

cases.name: pure-copy-cycle
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return b(n);} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: seeded-copy-cycle
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return n>1?b(n):0;} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: constructor-outside-cycle
cases.source: function wrapper(n:uint32){return [a(n)];} function a(n:uint32){return b(n);} function b(n:uint32){return n>1?a(n):0;} "ok";

cases.name: projection-cancels
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return {value:b(n)};} function b(n:uint32){return n>1?a(n).value:0;} "ok";

cases.name: unknown-absorbs
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32){return n>1?a(n):missing;} "ok";

cases.name: self-with-unknown-outgoing
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return n>1?[a(n)]:c(n);} function c(n:uint32){return missing;} "ok";

cases.name: unknown-outgoing
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return n>1?[b(n)]:c(n);} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} function c(n:uint32){return missing;} "ok";

cases.name: explicit-any-break
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32):any{return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: typed-property-break
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return {(value:any):b(n)};} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: parameter-shadow
cases.source: function a(b:any){return [b(b)];} function b(n:any){return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: stable-name-different-scope
cases.source: function b(n:uint32){return 0;} function outer(n:uint32){function a(m:uint32){return [b(m)];} return a(n);} "ok";

cases.name: reassigned-target
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return [b(n)];} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} b=function(n:uint32):number{return 0;}; "ok";

cases.name: seeded-copy-mismatch
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return n>1?b(n):0;} function b(n:uint32){return a(n);} const bad:string=a(0);

cases.name: projection-mismatch
cases.source: function a(n:uint32){return {value:b(n)};} function b(n:uint32){return n>1?a(n).value:0;} const bad:string=b(0);

cases.name: legacy-cycle-automatic
cases.source: function a(){return [b()];} function b(){return a();} "ok";

cases.name: legacy-cycle-forced
cases.source: function a(){return [b()];} function b(){return a();} "ok";

cases.name: legacy-cycle-disabled
cases.source: function a(){return [b()];} function b(){return a();} "ok";
